nodes.description: Constant uint MAX_NEB = 2500 capping total supply of NFT collection
Constant uint PURCHASE_LIMIT = 5 cap on tokens minted per transaction
String state variable holding the base token URI used by _baseURI
Boolean sale activation flag toggled by flipState and checked in mint
Constant uint256 NFT_PRICE = 0.04 ETH used as the per-token mint price
uint256 pseudo-random starting index for token reveal, set in calcStartingIndex
uint256 block number recorded to derive startingIndex randomness
NebulaFractal constructor initializing ERC721 name/symbol and calling setBaseURI
Payable public mint function that charges NFT_PRICE per token, mints via _safeMint and refunds overpayment with a low-level call
onlyOwner function deriving startingIndex from blockhash and normalized with modulo MAX_NEB
onlyOwner function recording current block.number into startingIndexBlock
Internal view override returning _baseTokenURI for tokenURI computation
onlyOwner function writing the base token URI into _baseTokenURI
External view function returning the list of token IDs owned by an address
onlyOwner function intended to reserve tokens and initialize startingIndexBlock
onlyOwner function setting isActive to enable or disable minting
onlyOwner function transferring the entire contract balance to msg.sender
Modifier requiring totalSupply() < MAX_NEB before the guarded function body
Caller-supplied address used as mint recipient, refund recipient and withdrawal destination
Low-level call msg.sender.call{value: remaining} refunding overpayment before state is finalized
Arithmetic NFT_PRICE.mul(_count) computing the required payment in mint
Arithmetic msg.value.sub(price) computing the refund amount in mint
Arithmetic startingIndex.add(1) used to avoid a zero starting index
Arithmetic block.number.sub(startingIndexBlock) used to detect stale blockhash randomness
payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance) sending the whole contract balance in withdrawAll
_safeMint/_checkOnERC721Received external callback into the recipient contract during minting
Parameter _count of mint controlling how many tokens are minted and the price
Parameter baseURI of setBaseURI written into _baseTokenURI
Parameter _owner of walletOfOwner whose token list is enumerated
Parameter num of reserveTokens controlling the reservation loop
Parameter val of flipState assigned to isActive
Local uint256 price = NFT_PRICE.mul(_count) inside mint
Local uint256 remaining = msg.value.sub(price) refunded via low-level call in mint
Local uint supply = totalSupply() inside reserveTokens
Local uint balance = address(this).balance inside withdrawAll
Local uint tokenCount = balanceOf(_owner) inside walletOfOwner

edges.reason: msg.sender is the recipient of the low-level refund call, allowing a malicious contract to reenter mint while the refund is sent
msg.sender is the recipient passed to _safeMint, which triggers the onERC721Received callback during minting
mint executes the external msg.sender.call{value: remaining} before completing accounting, enabling reentrancy
mint calls _safeMint inside the mint loop, invoking an external callback on the recipient
mint performs the price multiplication NFT_PRICE.mul(_count) to compute the required payment
mint performs msg.value.sub(price) to compute the overpayment refund
mint enforces the PURCHASE_LIMIT constant on the per-transaction token count
mint reads the NFT_PRICE constant to derive the payment amount
mint checks total supply against the MAX_NEB cap
mint requires isActive to be true before allowing purchases
calcStartingIndex performs startingIndex.add(1) to avoid a zero starting index
calcStartingIndex performs block.number.sub(startingIndexBlock) to check blockhash staleness
calcStartingIndex assigns the derived value to startingIndex
calcStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to compute the blockhash based randomness
calcStartingIndex reduces the blockhash modulo MAX_NEB
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes block.number into startingIndexBlock
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock reads startingIndex as a guard condition
withdrawAll transfers the whole balance through payable(msg.sender).transfer
withdrawAll sends funds to msg.sender and is protected only by the onlyOwner modifier
saleIsOpen requires totalSupply() to remain below MAX_NEB
saleIsOpen modifier guards the entry of mint
flipState writes the val parameter into the isActive state variable
setBaseURI writes the supplied URI into _baseTokenURI
_baseURI returns the _baseTokenURI state variable
the constructor calls setBaseURI to initialize the token URI
_checkOnERC721Received invokes IERC721Receiver(msg.sender).onERC721Received, an external callback into the buyer contract
_count is the mint parameter that drives the minting loop
_count is the multiplicand in NFT_PRICE.mul(_count)
price feeds the msg.value.sub(price) refund computation
remaining is the value forwarded in the low-level refund call to msg.sender
supply derived from totalSupply() is used in the reserveTokens loop
balance is the amount transferred in withdrawAll
tokenCount sizes the array returned by walletOfOwner
baseURI parameter is stored by setBaseURI
_owner parameter selects the balance and token list in walletOfOwner
num parameter bounds the reserveTokens enumeration loop
val parameter is assigned to isActive in flipState
